precondition: Test build of frontend + backend; Organizer, Member and Administrator accounts supplied by QA lead; meetings in several statuses and months for the Organizer; Chrome and a second browser for the two-user cases; Excel.

cases.description: Report opens from the sidebar with the default twelve months.
procedure: Sign in as any internal user and click "Báo cáo" in the sidebar.
expected: The browser opens /mgmt/reports; backend answers GET /api/reports/meetings with 200 for the default period.
Title "Báo cáo" with the line "<n> cuộc họp" under it; pickers "Từ" and "đến" show the month twelve months ago and the current month as "Tháng MM/yyyy".
Cards "Tổng quan", "Theo tháng", "Theo trạng thái" and "Theo mức độ" appear; the toolbar shows "Số liệu lúc <time>".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user who can read meetings in the last twelve months.

cases.description: Report shows counts by month, status and sensitivity as tables.
procedure: Read the cards "Theo tháng", "Theo trạng thái" and "Theo mức độ".
expected: "Theo tháng" lists 01/2026, 02/2026 and 03/2026 with "Số cuộc họp"; a month with no meeting shows a dimmed 0, and the bar of the busiest month is the longest.

"Theo trạng thái" lists all 8 statuses with their badges (for example "Nháp", "Đã công bố", "Đã kết thúc", "Đã huỷ") and "Theo mức độ" lists "Thường", "Nội bộ", "Mật"; zero counts are dimmed, not hidden.
No meeting title, id or participant is shown anywhere.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with meetings in 01/2026–03/2026.

cases.description: Overview shows the three averages with the meetings they are based on.
procedure: Read the card "Tổng quan" and hover the (i) beside each metric.
expected: Rows "Tỷ lệ tham dự trung bình" (for example "87 %"), "Thời lượng họp trung bình" (for example "1 giờ 35 phút") and "Từ kết thúc tới ban hành biên bản" (for example "30,5 giờ", or in days from 48 hours), each with "trên x/y cuộc họp".
Each (i) explains how the value is computed; a metric with no data reads "Chưa có dữ liệu".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with Ended meetings, some with attendance and issued minutes.

cases.description: Changing a month updates the URL and the figures, and survives a reload.
expected: The URL becomes /mgmt/reports?from=<yyyy-MM>&to=<yyyy-MM> without adding a history entry; figures refresh with the previous ones dimmed while loading.
After the reload the same period and figures are shown.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user.

cases.description: Choosing a start month after the end month moves the end month with it.
expected: "đến" becomes "Tháng 06/2026"; no error appears and the figures for June load.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user.

cases.description: Choosing a period longer than 24 months moves the other end.
expected: "đến" moves to "Tháng 12/2025" so that the period is 24 months; figures load and no error appears.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user.

cases.description: A period typed in the URL that breaks BR-433 shows the error and calls no API.
expected: Under the toolbar: "Khoảng thời gian không hợp lệ. Chọn tối đa 24 tháng, tháng bắt đầu không sau tháng kết thúc."; no figures are shown, the browser sends no GET /api/reports/meetings, and "Xuất Excel" is disabled.
Choosing a valid month clears the message and loads the figures.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user.

cases.description: A malformed month in the URL is ignored.
expected: The page shows the default twelve months; no error message; the pickers show the default months.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user.

cases.description: Period with no readable meeting shows the empty message.
expected: Backend answers 200 with "total": 0; the page shows "Không có cuộc họp nào bạn xem được trong khoảng này." (MSG466, produced by the frontend) instead of the tables.
"Xuất Excel" stays enabled.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an account that created no meeting and is on none.

cases.description: Report shows an error with a retry button when the backend fails.
procedure: Open /mgmt/reports while QA lead has the database stopped.
Ask QA lead to start the database, then click "Thử lại".
expected: Backend answers 500/MSG464; a red alert "Không tải được báo cáo. Vui lòng thử lại." with the button "Thử lại" replaces the figures.
After "Thử lại" the figures load.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
QA lead can stop and start the database of the test build.

cases.description: Report counts only the meetings the viewer may read.
procedure: As user A (Organizer) open /mgmt/reports?from=2026-01&to=2026-12 and note "<n> cuộc họp".
As user B, who is on none of A's meetings, open the same URL.
expected: A sees A's meetings counted; B sees only the meetings B can read, so a Draft meeting of A is in A's total but not B's.
The Administrator also sees only the meetings the Administrator can read.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Two accounts supplied by QA lead in two browsers; A has Draft meetings B cannot read.

cases.description: Report is reachable without any capability, and a Guest cannot use it.
procedure: Sign in as a Member with no administrative capability and click "Báo cáo".
Using the Guest token of an invitation link, request GET /api/reports/meetings.
expected: Step 1: the page opens and loads figures.
Step 2: the backend answers 403 with no message code; a Guest has no internal account and no report.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
A Member account and a Guest invitation link.

cases.description: Report page asks a signed-out visitor to sign in.
expected: The app redirects to /login; no report data is returned (the API answers 401).
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
No active session.

cases.description: Excel export downloads the figures of the period on screen.
procedure: Open the downloaded file in Excel.
expected: The button reads "Đang xuất…" while the request runs; backend answers 200 and the browser saves bao-cao-cuoc-hop_2026-02_2026-03.xlsx.
The sheet "Báo cáo cuộc họp" shows the period, the total, the month, status and sensitivity tables with Vietnamese labels, and the three averages (or "Chưa có dữ liệu"); no meeting title appears.
An audit row "report.exported" is recorded for the user.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with meetings in 02/2026–03/2026; Excel on the tester machine.

cases.description: Excel export is disabled for an invalid period.
expected: "Xuất Excel" is disabled and the MSG463 message shows under the toolbar; no export request is sent.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user.

cases.description: Export failure shows an error toast and no file is saved.
procedure: Ask QA lead to stop the database, then click "Xuất Excel".
expected: Backend answers 500/MSG465; a toast "Không xuất được báo cáo. Vui lòng thử lại." appears, no file is downloaded and no audit row is written.
The button returns to "Xuất Excel" and the page stays on /mgmt/reports.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Report loaded; QA lead can stop the database of the test build.

cases.description: Excel export works for a period with no readable meeting.
procedure: Open /mgmt/reports?from=2026-01&to=2026-12 with an account that can read no meeting.
expected: A file bao-cao-cuoc-hop_2026-01_2026-12.xlsx is saved with total 0, every row 0 and the averages "Chưa có dữ liệu".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an account that created no meeting and is on none.
